text: Mr. Godfrey recently disclosed on his network radio show an encounter he had with a UFO several years ago.
Godfrey is an accomplished pilot, and the sighting took place as he was flying his private plane from New York to Washington.
Near Philadelphia, Godfrey and his co-pilot radioed the Federal Aviation Agency tower in the city
and reported a near brush with a brilliantly lighted object.
The tower confirmed that there was no air traffic scheduled near the area at the time.
Godfrey reported that the object paced his plane off his right wing,
circled the aircraft and came up on the left.
He said he put his plane through several evasive maneuvers,
but the UFO followed closely no matter what he did.
It was a few minutes later that the object veered off and disappeared in the distance.
Godfrey, a reliable pilot with everything from propeller planes
to Air Force jet flights behind him, is a colonel in the Air Force Reserve.
